svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"非空蛋糕段：先查旧前缀，再插入当前前缀","steps":[{"caption":"右端 1：只查 j∈[0,0]，-2−(0)=-2。当前前缀还不能作左边界。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"query","i":1,"j":0,"queue":[0],"prefix":[0,-2,1,0,4,-1],"value":-2,"best":-2}},{"caption":"现在才插入前缀 1，移除较大或相等的旧前缀。它只服务后续右端。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"insert","i":1,"queue":[1],"removed":[0]}},{"caption":"右端 2：只查 j∈[0,1]，1−(-2)=3。当前前缀还不能作左边界。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"query","i":2,"j":1,"queue":[1],"prefix":[0,-2,1,0,4,-1],"value":3,"best":3}},{"caption":"现在才插入前缀 2，移除较大或相等的旧前缀。它只服务后续右端。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"insert","i":2,"queue":[1,2],"removed":[]}},{"caption":"右端 3：只查 j∈[0,2]，0−(-2)=2。当前前缀还不能作左边界。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"query","i":3,"j":1,"queue":[1,2],"prefix":[0,-2,1,0,4,-1],"value":2,"best":3}},{"caption":"现在才插入前缀 3，移除较大或相等的旧前缀。它只服务后续右端。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"insert","i":3,"queue":[1,3],"removed":[2]}},{"caption":"右端 4：只查 j∈[1,3]，4−(-2)=6。当前前缀还不能作左边界。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"query","i":4,"j":1,"queue":[1,3],"prefix":[0,-2,1,0,4,-1],"value":6,"best":6}},{"caption":"现在才插入前缀 4，移除较大或相等的旧前缀。它只服务后续右端。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"insert","i":4,"queue":[1,3,4],"removed":[]}},{"caption":"右端 5：只查 j∈[2,4]，-1−(0)=-1。当前前缀还不能作左边界。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"query","i":5,"j":3,"queue":[3,4],"prefix":[0,-2,1,0,4,-1],"value":-1,"best":6}},{"caption":"现在才插入前缀 5，移除较大或相等的旧前缀。它只服务后续右端。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":"insert","i":5,"queue":[5],"removed":[4,3]}}]}
